title: Thai Skewers with Lemon-Oven Glaze
description: A fusion of Thai flavors and Slovakian roasting techniques in a delicious and easy-to-make dish. The tender chicken is perfectly balanced by the sweet and tangy lemon glaze.
instructions: Cut the chicken into 2cm cubes and thread onto the skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, brown sugar, soy sauce, and olive oil.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the bowl and whisk until combined.
Season the mixture with salt and pepper to taste.
Brush the mixture onto both sides of the chicken on the skewers.
Place the skewers on a baking tray and roast in the oven for 15 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and brush with the lemon-oven glaze.
Return the skewers to the oven for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until cooked through.
